notes: Registration, login, logout, reviews, review management, helpful reactions, saved beers, followed members, forum threads, replies, and local contributions are stored in the site-bound SQLite runtime.
Registration challenges are completed internally from the local outbox and are never displayed or sent.
Password-recovery requests use an indistinguishable local-only start response, but password replacement is disabled until an independent account-control channel exists.
Review media uses a bounded selection of already-localized assets; arbitrary user upload remains disabled.
No real email, source-site account, source mutation, arbitrary upload, checkout, or payment is in scope.
